text:
ITEM 1 | Pizza slice, rectangular wedge about 12 cm long and 6 cm wide at the thickest edge; top layer of melted white cheese with orange-red sauce spots and light browning across the surface; crust edge is pale golden-brown with darker charred spots on the underside edge; cheese looks glossy and slightly oily where it has melted | 150
ITEM 2 | Broccoli florets, cluster of about 6 to 8 florets roughly 5 to 6 cm across, bright green with darker green tips, firm stems visible at the base, slightly glossy and moist surface | 70
ITEM 3 | Sliced meat pieces, several irregular flat pieces about 4 to 6 cm long and 1 to 1.5 cm thick, grayish-brown to tan with darker brown edges, fibrous grain visible, appears moist with a light sheen, some bits of dark green herb or seasoning scattered on top | 90
ITEM 4 | Folded pastry or wrapped item, one piece about 6 cm long and 3 cm wide, golden-tan with flaky layered edges, some darker browned patches, appears lightly oily, sitting beside the meat slices | 45
ITEM 5 | Orange sauce or dressing smear, small irregular patches about 3 cm across at the upper right edge of the plate and a few crumbs, bright orange-red, slightly glossy and semi-thick, partly spread on the plate surface | 15
